#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

name: read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue causing the password reset email to link to localhost is due to the BASE_URL constant in src/notifications/templates.ts defaulting to "http://localhost:3000" when the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is not set. This means in deployments or environments where PUBLIC_URL is not configured, the emails will contain localhost links, which are not accessible externally. To fix this, the deployment configuration should ensure PUBLIC_URL is correctly set to the app's external URL, or the code should be updated to use a more appropriate default.
